debug.description: Enable verbose logging for plugin execution (helps debugging but increases log volume).

plugins.description: List of client-side Xymon plugins to launch with their configuration.

name.description: Unique name for the plugin (used as command name and for status tracking).

enabled.description: If false, the plugin line is commented out (plugin disabled).

interval.description: How often (in seconds) the plugin should be executed.

cmd.description: Absolute path to the plugin executable (e.g., /usr/lib/xymon/client/bin/test-ram).

args.description: List of arguments passed to the plugin command.

env.description: List of environment variable assignments (e.g., ['XymonClientHome=/usr/lib/xymon/client']) passed before the command.

description.description: Brief human-readable description of what the plugin does (used for documentation).
